tools.name: wise_report
tools.description: Tell the orchestrator how you are doing. kind progress: milestone reached; blocker: something stops you; decision: a choice you made; finding: a fact worth recording. Keep text to one line.

text.description: One line, <= 200 chars; longer text is clipped.

data.description: Small JSON payload, <= 1 kB; dropped when larger.

tools.name: wise_ask
tools.description: Ask the human a question and wait for the answer. Blocks until answered; returns {value}. Give options when a choice is enough. In an unattended run the answer comes from the run's recorded decisions or the first option; {error: 'needs-human'} means proceed with your best judgement.

allow_text.description: Accept free text; default true when no options.

tools.name: wise_context
tools.description: Fetch run context by key instead of guessing: ticket (array of {ref, title, url, path}; Read `path` for the ticket's content, `body` appears only when no file was written), guidance, decisions, links, a prior step's output by name or step id, or an input. Returns {value}; null when unknown.

key.description: ticket | guidance | decisions | links | <output name> | <step id> | <input name>

tools.name: wise_checkpoint
tools.description: Save partial results as JSON so they survive if you are stopped. Overwrites the previous checkpoint.
